title: PEACEMAKER OR TROUBLEMAKER: HOW SYCOPHANCY SHAPES MULTI-AGENT DEBATE
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical and behavioral impact of sycophancy on reasoning performance and agreement status in multi-agent debating systems using benchmarks like MMLU Pro and CommonsenseQA. While sycophancy is a behavioral trait with social implications, the research does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
